purpose: Convert the Phase Q dependency inventory into a separable operator/product-authority decision docket. Options and test obligations are explicit, but no option is selected, no policy is adopted, and no renderer or binding authority is created.

authority_and_decision_rules.decision_record: Any adopted choice must be captured in a separate, immutable, add-only decision record that names the authority, exact policy, scope, source pins, rationale, and acceptance tests.
authority_and_decision_rules.CHALLENGE_008_009: No duration correction may be inferred from phase names, visual plausibility, or convenience; explicit authority is required.
authority_and_decision_rules.future_binding: A policy decision packet alone never authorizes a binding, custom_data access, renderer projection, payload, media, or release. Each remains subject to its own governed gate.

candidate_semantics.accepted_semantics: float scalar X, per-frame, from pilot domain 0..100
candidate_semantics.not_authorized: Any source Y, a Vector2 replacement, or rendering/binding

candidate_semantics.accepted_semantics: Vector2 target point constant per run and repeated across source frames
candidate_semantics.not_authorized: Treating it as a dynamic trajectory or replacing snapshot.position
Replacing catcher snapshot.position, interpolation/extrapolation, or rendering/binding
candidate_semantics.source_relation: CatchMechanic emits p_t per source frame

candidate_semantics.not_authorized: Distractor topology/distances, scoring/success telemetry, or close_calls as visual source
candidate_semantics.source_relation: FindMechanic.calculate_frame emits p_target per source frame

candidate_semantics.accepted_semantics: Integer selection state only; semantic/presentation dependency unresolved
candidate_semantics.not_authorized: Secondary visual consumer, duration fix, or fallback inferred from snapshot.position
candidate_semantics.source_relation: ChooseMechanic writes the selected option index; snapshot.position already maps options_positions[selection] with a center fallback for invalid indices

candidate_semantics.accepted_semantics: Integer current displayed state; distinct from target_count
candidate_semantics.not_authorized: Text/layout emission, use of target_count as displayed state, or duration fix
candidate_semantics.source_relation: CountMechanic writes displayed_count; snapshot.position is calculated from the displayed value; target_count remains a separate goal value

decisions.title: Source 60 FPS to delivery 30 FPS sampling
decisions.question: Which exact source frame indices and duration/boundary semantics map to each 30 FPS delivery frame?

options.definition: Use explicitly enumerated source indices 0,2,4,... with exact cardinality derived from an approved duration convention.
options.consequence: Simple deterministic decimation; drops odd source frames and still requires a defined endpoint/duration contract.

options.definition: Define delivery times and an explicit source-boundary/nearest-sample policy including tie behavior.
options.consequence: Can express timing precisely but must specify half-open/closed boundaries and tie handling; existing proposal is not globally approved.

options.definition: Do not map samples until the product/contract authority selects and records one policy.
options.consequence: No binding or rendering work may depend on this timebase yet.

non_negotiables: No interpolation or extrapolation unless separately authorized by a new reviewed policy.
No synthetic source samples.
No blanket 2:1 assumption without an explicit selected rule.
Repeat determinism is necessary but not proof of visual correctness.
decisions.authority_required: Product/contract owner for the delivery timeline; operator records the authoritative decision.
future_tests: Exact source index list and cardinality

decisions.title: Coordinate transforms for Vector2 candidates
decisions.question: Approve the proposed two-stage transform, reject it, or require a different explicitly specified mapping?

options.definition: Source canvas 1080x1920 to logical 540x960 at 0.5, then logical to delivery reference 720x1280 at 4/3.
options.consequence: Composite scale is 2/3 only if both stages and their coordinate origins are formally adopted; known-point and boundary tests remain mandatory.

options.definition: Reject the proposal and require a new transform contract with source/destination spaces and origin conventions.
options.consequence: No transform can be used pending a separately reviewed replacement.

options.definition: Make no transform decision now.
options.consequence: Vector candidates remain non-renderable and unbound.

non_negotiables: Do not infer coordinate space from value shape.
No clamping of out-of-domain vectors.
Do not include CHALLENGE_008/009 in this decision while their timebase and semantic role remain blocked.
decisions.authority_required: Product/visual-design authority for reference canvas and spatial contract.

decisions.title: CHALLENGE_003 scalar X and separate presentation-only Y
decisions.question: Decide whether to adopt the proposed X mapping and whether a separate presentation-only centerline Y=480 is permitted.

options.definition: Review X=(target_x/100)*540 and independently approve Y=480 as presentation policy, not source data.
options.consequence: Requires two explicit decisions; neither may be inferred from the scalar or provenance report.

options.definition: Approve an X transform only; withhold visual placement until Y ownership is separately specified.
options.consequence: Scalar source remains one-dimensional and cannot alone define a full 2D point.

options.definition: Reject the proposed map or defer all decisions.
options.consequence: No position or rendering can be derived from target_x under this packet.

non_negotiables: target_x remains float scalar.
snapshot.position is a separate track.
Never store an invented Y into source data or retype the candidate as Vector2.
future_tests: Known X endpoints and representative values
Y policy independently traced as presentation-only
No inferred Y in source provenance

decisions.title: Visible region and temporal visibility span
decisions.question: For each selector, identify the owning region/actor and exact visibility interval/cardinality.

options.definition: Adopt full-source-frame-span visibility separately for each candidate after authority review.
options.consequence: May keep targets visible outside meaningful gameplay phases; requires proof and exact cardinality tests.

options.definition: Adopt a source-authored window with exact inclusive/exclusive boundaries and ownership.
options.consequence: Requires a grounded source/contract definition for every window; cannot derive from phase names alone.

options.definition: Do not define visibility yet.
options.consequence: No visibility rule can be used by a renderer or binding.

non_negotiables: Phase P provenance is not visibility approval.
Do not use close_calls to infer visibility.
Do not infer regional ownership from asset names.
decisions.authority_required: Product/visual-design authority for visible behavior and region ownership.

decisions.title: SVG intrinsic dimensions, anchor, clipping and pixel rounding
decisions.question: Adopt or reject asset-size interpretation, center anchor, edge clipping and exact deterministic rounding rules.

options.definition: Treat intrinsic 100x100 SVG size as source canvas units, use center anchor, clip at logical bounds, and separately define one exact pixel-rounding mode.
options.consequence: Requires asset inspection and explicit rounding mode before it is testable; the rounding choice cannot be left implicit.

options.definition: Do not use intrinsic SVG dimensions as scale units; require a separately governed asset geometry declaration.
options.consequence: Adds metadata contract and validation work but avoids an implicit asset-unit assumption.

options.definition: Leave size/anchor/crop/rounding unresolved.
options.consequence: No final renderer geometry may be defined.

non_negotiables: No silent source-position movement to avoid clipping.
No unstated rounding behavior.
Malformed/missing intrinsic geometry fails closed.
decisions.authority_required: Product/visual-design authority for asset sizing and crop; renderer-contract owner for rounding semantics.

decisions.title: Missing, malformed, nonfinite, out-of-range and cardinality mismatch handling
decisions.question: Formalize per-candidate fail-closed behavior and whole-track versus per-sample rejection.

options.definition: Reject the whole candidate track if any required sample is missing, malformed, nonfinite, out of domain, or cardinality-inconsistent; never clamp.
options.consequence: Conservative and straightforward to audit; one bad sample invalidates the candidate track.

options.definition: Permit rejection of a bad sample only if a separately reviewed contract specifies the gap semantics and proves no interpolation or extrapolation.
options.consequence: More complex; must not be assumed equivalent to whole-track rejection.

options.definition: Do not specify a future binding contract until the policy is decided.
options.consequence: No candidate data may be consumed for rendering.

non_negotiables: NaN/Infinity invalid.
No silent coercion or clamping.
No whole custom_data map serialization.
Receipts must not serialize raw candidate values.
decisions.authority_required: Data-contract owner, with operator recording the precise invalid-data rule.

decisions.title: Whether each accepted semantic candidate has a distinct visual consumer
decisions.question: For each selector, declare the visual entity/region it represents and whether it adds information not already represented by snapshot.position.

options.definition: Record a separate owner, asset/region, semantic role and proof that the candidate adds distinct visual information.
options.consequence: Requires exact per-selector design authority and prevents semantic aliases from becoming implicit duplicate sprites.

options.definition: Explicitly state the field is not separately projected into visuals.
options.consequence: The candidate does not become a renderer binding; existing snapshot.position behavior remains governed independently.

options.definition: Do not infer any visual consumer or owner.
options.consequence: All candidate visual consumption remains unauthorized.

non_negotiables: CHALLENGE_003 target_x never supplies source Y.
CHALLENGE_005 target_position is per-run constant.
CHALLENGE_006/007 target_position are per-frame tracks.
CHALLENGE_007 distractor topology/distances, success/scoring telemetry and close_calls are excluded.
CHALLENGE_008 active_selection may be redundant with snapshot.position and remains blocked.
CHALLENGE_009 displayed_count is not target_count and does not authorize text/layout output.
decisions.authority_required: Product authority for visible semantics and actor/region ownership.
future_tests: Only explicitly allowlisted fields appear in later contracts

decisions.title: CHALLENGE_008 declared duration versus phase sum
decisions.question: Which authoritative source/contract value governs, and what explicit correction or exception is authorized?

options.definition: Authorized owner issues a separately governed change to the authoritative source/contract and its dependent pins/tests.
options.consequence: Requires new reviewed evidence and revalidation; never edit the challenge JSON informally.

options.definition: Authorized owner documents a precise reason why declared duration and phase sum may differ, with consumer semantics and test expectations.
options.consequence: Must be explicit and versioned; cannot be inferred by the review packet.

options.definition: Leave the conflict unresolved and keep CHALLENGE_008 blocked.
options.consequence: No timebase/sampling or visual policy can adopt this selector.

decisions.authority_required: Explicit owner of challenge timing/product contract; operator records immutable decision evidence.
future_tests: Declared duration and phase boundaries reconciled or exception proved
All affected source pins and regressions refreshed

decisions.title: CHALLENGE_009 declared duration versus phase sum and displayed-count ownership
decisions.question: Resolve timing under explicit authority, then decide whether displayed_count has a visual role distinct from current position and distinct from target_count.

options.definition: Authorized owner governs the duration and explicitly defines what displayed_count represents visually, if anything.
options.consequence: Requires timing and semantic evidence plus future tests; does not authorize text/layout by itself.

options.definition: Authorized owner documents an explicit timing exception and distinct count semantics, with tests.
options.consequence: Versioned exception must distinguish current displayed state from target_count.

options.definition: Keep both the timing conflict and presentation role unresolved.
options.consequence: No sampling, text/layout or renderer policy can use displayed_count.

decisions.authority_required: Explicit owner of challenge timing/product contract and count presentation; operator records immutable decision evidence.
future_tests: 11 versus 12 seconds reconciled or an explicit exception is proved
Presentation owner/asset/region defined or explicitly none
Affected source pins and regressions refreshed

future_gate_requirements.required_artifacts_before_any_binding_sp: Separate signed/authorized decisions with exact scopes, source pins, rationale, selected options, and accepted future-test criteria.
future_gate_requirements.later_binding_specification: New separately governed gate, allowlist only, no blanket custom_data access.
future_gate_requirements.runtime_render_gate: Not covered by Phase R; remains blocked until every prerequisite gate and approval is complete.
future_gate_requirements.C11C: Keep frozen authoritative baseline immutable until C11-D is formally approved, frozen, and promoted.

phase_r_exit_criteria: Packet and schema validate; no decision option is selected by this artifact.
All nine decision IDs exist with explicit authority, options, consequences, and future tests.
CHALLENGE_008 and CHALLENGE_009 11s/12s conflicts remain preserved and blocked.
Current Phase Q and Phase P source pins reconcile.
Static test passes without Godot, renderer, payload, media, or production code changes.
Any future policy adoption occurs only in a separate explicit decision artifact.

next_gate.name: Phase S — authorized policy decision record and adjudication, only after explicit operator/product choices are supplied
next_gate.start_condition: Phase R packet is accepted as decision preparation. No policy is adopted simply by closing Phase R.
